nized with agent tool calls.
# dsh-wordcraft
**WordCraft editor panel for DeepSeek Harness** — open a real, editable Word document in DSH's right
Sidebar Browser and watch the agent edit it live, in the same editor session.
> Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with DeepSeek or the WordCraft/ArtCraft teams.
## What it does
- Registers one general `wordcraft-editor` skill for the parts an agent gets wrong unprompted: panel
handoff and attachment, editor-session and cursor semantics, Word layout checks (sections, TOC/capt

ion fields, tables, pagination) and save/verify rules. No scenario writing templates.
- Starts one s

tdio MCP server, `wordcraft-editor`, over a bundled WordCraft runtime — no download at first use.
-
Serves the editor panel over a loopback HTTP URL with a random token. Click the link the agent print

s: DSH opens it in the right Sidebar Browser.
- Keeps the panel and the agent on **one editor sessio
n**: `editor_status.attached` turns true once the page is loaded, and every `type_text` / `execute`
call shows up in the panel immediately.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (declared through `engines.dsh`).
- Node.js 24 or newer (th

e bundled editor runtime requires it).
- The right Sidebar Browser enabled in your Web profile (DSH
ships it disabled for Web; see below).
## Install
From GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Enable the right Sidebar Browser (one-time, in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH, then ask in a new session:
> 用 WordCraft 打开编辑器，帮我把这份周报整理成 DOCX。
The agent calls `open_browser_editor`, prints a `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<token>/` link, and waits u
ntil `editor_status` reports `attached: true` (usually 8–20 seconds). Click the link — the editor op
ens beside the chat and shares the agent's session.
If clicking the link opens a browser tab instead of the sidebar, set **Settings → General → link ope
ning → In-App Sidebar**.
### Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Remove the `ui-sidebar-browser` entry again if you no longer want the browser panel.
## How it works
1. `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the skill provider (`lib/index.js`) and one MCP client row (`wordcraft

-editor` → `ui/bootstrap.mjs`).
2. `ui/bootstrap.mjs` verifies the bundled runtime against `ui/runti

me.lock.json` (45 pinned files) and starts the editor adapter.
3. The adapter (`src/adapter.mjs`, bu
ndled to `ui/dist/adapter.mjs`) exposes the editor's MCP tools and a loopback browser page. The pane
l talks to the adapter through the same MCP session the agent uses, which is why edits are shared ra

ther than copied.
4. Every editor asset is served through chunked MCP resources (2 MiB per chunk); t
he panel runs as WebAssembly.
## Security and limits
- One workspace per MCP instance: the first `open_editor` call binds the workspace; switching requir

es restarting DSH. Paths outside the workspace are rejected.
- The loopback page uses a random token
and `Host`/`Origin` checks; no Node.js APIs are exposed to the page. The runtime is verified by SHA

-256 before it runs and is never downloaded at runtime.
- The project bundles a pinned, prebuilt edi

tor runtime; the panel UI has no network access (`connect-src 'none'`).
- Web sidebar iframes do not
have the download permission: exports made inside the panel are written to `<workspace>/craft-expor

ts/`; prefer `save_document` for deliverables.
- WordCraft's native CLI and the editor panel are sep
arate sessions; save and reopen before switching.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The prebuilt WordCraft editor binary under `ui/dist/editor/` is a pinned artifact: run `node scripts
/update-runtime-lock.mjs` after an intentional change and keep `ui/runtime.lock.json` in sync (`npm
test` reports mismatches).
## License and provenance
Apache-2.0 for this plugin's own code. The bundled WordCraft runtime and its automation overlay carr
y their own licenses and notices — see LICENSE, NOTICE, PROVENANCE.md and the complete third-party n
otices in `ui/dist/editor/licenses/`.
The modified editor build follows the WordCraft brand license: product, community and brand referenc
es were removed or replaced, while copyright attribution and every upstream license/notice file are
emoved or replaced, while copyright attribution and every upstream license/notice file are retained.
